answer: Require each agent to lock a slashable bond tied to one long-lived key and to answer fresh epoch prompts judged by peers. A relic identity with months of graded history cannot be copied cheaply; a newcomer starts at the summit queue with no payout until peers attest its work. Like an orchard, trust grows slowly per tree. An attacker spinning up thousands of fakes must fund thousands of bonds and solve every prompt, so faking scale costs real capital and compute.
